title: Barnes--Rivers Lorentz spin projectors on symmetric rank-2 tensors in d=5
expression_sketch: d=5 spacetime, Lorentz indices mu,nu,rho,sigma,alpha,beta in {0,1,2,3,4}. Flat metric eta of any fixed nondegenerate signature. Momentum k with k^2 := eta^{alpha beta} k_alpha k_beta nonzero. Transverse and longitudinal vector projectors: theta(mu,nu) = eta(mu,nu) - k(mu)*k(nu)/k^2,  omega(mu,nu) = k(mu)*k(nu)/k^2. Algebra: theta+omega=eta, theta*theta=theta, omega*omega=omega, theta*omega=0. Identity on symmetric rank-2 tensors: I(mu,nu;rho,sigma) = (1/2)*(eta(mu,rho)*eta(nu,sigma)+eta(mu,sigma)*eta(nu,rho)). Barnes--Rivers spin projectors (n-dimensional; Buchbinder--Shapiro / Haber-style 1/(d-1) not 1/3): P2(mu,nu;rho,sigma) = (1/2)*(theta(mu,rho)*theta(nu,sigma)+theta(mu,sigma)*theta(nu,rho)) - (1/(d-1))*theta(mu,nu)*theta(rho,sigma); P1(mu,nu;rho,sigma) = (1/2)*(theta(mu,rho)*omega(nu,sigma)+theta(mu,sigma)*omega(nu,rho)+theta(nu,rho)*omega(mu,sigma)+theta(nu,sigma)*omega(mu,rho)); P0s(mu,nu;rho,sigma) = (1/(d-1))*theta(mu,nu)*theta(rho,sigma); P0w(mu,nu;rho,sigma) = omega(mu,nu)*omega(rho,sigma). With d=5, 1/(d-1)=1/4. Completeness: I = P2+P1+P0s+P0w. Orthogonality: P_X(mu,nu;alpha,beta)*P_Y(alpha,beta;rho,sigma) = delta(X,Y)*P_X(mu,nu;rho,sigma). Traces (massive little-group SO(d-1) dimensions): Tr P2 = d(d-1)/2 - 1 = 9, Tr P1 = d-1 = 4, Tr P0s = Tr P0w = 1, summing to d(d+1)/2 = 15.
latent_structure: Little-group SO(d-1) irrep decomposition of a massive symmetric rank-2 Lorentz tensor: spin 2 (transverse traceless), spin 1 (transverse vector), and two spin-0 channels (spatial trace vs longitudinal scalar). Orthogonal projectors built from theta, omega; the coefficient 1/(d-1) is the d-dimensional replacement of the 4D 1/3. Not the SO(3) isotropic elasticity split of ac-t-iso4-projectors (no momentum, d=3, volumetric/deviatoric).

function_domains.eta: Constant nondegenerate symmetric metric on R^{1,4} or R^5; used only algebraically to raise/lower k and to form traces.
function_domains.k: Covector with k^2 = eta^{ab} k_a k_b nonzero.
function_domains.theta: Transverse projector eta - k k / k^2.
function_domains.P2: Spin-2 transverse-traceless projector on symmetric rank-2 tensors.
function_domains.P1: Spin-1 projector (transverse vector inside a symmetric tensor).

nonzero_conditions.statement: k^2 != 0, so that omega = k k / k^2 and theta = eta - omega are defined as rational tensors in k.
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Barnes, J. Math. Phys. 6 (1965) 788; Buchbinder--Shapiro QG notes, momentum-space theta/omega

nonzero_conditions.statement: d=5, hence d-1=4 != 0, so the coefficient 1/(d-1) in P2 and P0s is defined in Q.
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: n-dimensional Barnes--Rivers formulae (Buchbinder--Shapiro; arXiv:2210.12319 eq. (69)); d=5 is a declared specialization with d != 4

nonzero_conditions.statement: eta is nondegenerate, so eta^{mu nu} exists.
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Lorentzian or Euclidean flat metric in the cited projector algebra

branch_conventions: No square roots: k^2 is inverted as a rational scalar, not a mass-shell square root.
source_provenance: K. J. Barnes, Lagrangian theory for the second-rank tensor field, J. Math. Phys. 6 (1965) 788--794.
R. J. Rivers, Lagrangian theory for neutral massive spin-2 fields, Nuovo Cimento 34 (1964) 386.
I. L. Buchbinder and I. L. Shapiro, Introduction to Quantum Field Theory with Applications to Quantum Gravity, OUP, eqs. (18.57)--(18.59) (n-dimensional Barnes--Rivers: 1/(n-1) in P^(2) and P^(0-s)).
I. L. Shapiro, The background information about perturbative quantum gravity, arXiv:2210.12319, eq. (69).
P. van Nieuwenhuizen, Radiation of massive gravitation, Phys. Rev. D 7 (1973) 2300 (4D special case; not the d=5 formulae used here).

derived_conditions.statement: P2+P0s equals the symmetrized theta tensor product (1/2)(theta tensor theta)_sym, so they split the transverse-symmetric subspace into traceless spin-2 and a scalar trace.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: adding the displayed P2 and P0s; Buchbinder--Shapiro completeness

derived_conditions.statement: Massive spin-2 is the STF rank-2 irrep of the little group SO(d-1), of dimension (d-1)d/2 - 1. At d=5 this is 9, matching Tr P2. (The massless formula d(d-3)/2 is not this projector.)
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: little-group SO(d-1); STF dimension n(n+1)/2-1 with n=d-1; Barnes 1965 / Buchbinder--Shapiro completeness

public_source: Barnes JMP 6 (1965); Rivers 1964; Buchbinder--Shapiro n-dimensional projectors 1/(n-1); Shapiro arXiv:2210.12319 eq. (69)
why_not_cse_lgg: A generic 5x5 symmetric tensor in momentum space has 15 components; CSE will not invent the four orthogonal spin projectors or the 1/(d-1) trace subtraction. LGG has no little-group constructor. Distinct from 3D isotropic elasticity projectors (no k, coefficient 1/3, SO(3)).
proposer_leak_risk: Hide Barnes--Rivers, graviton, spin-2, van Nieuwenhuizen, TT projector, Fierz--Pauli. Show only theta/omega combinations without spin labels.
notes: Algebraic rational identity in (eta,k) on the open set k^2 != 0. d=5 is declared so that 1/(d-1)=1/4 is not the 4D coefficient 1/3 and not the 3D elasticity 1/3 of ac-t-iso4-projectors. Signature of eta is not used beyond invertibility.
